def _pbNextComb(comb, length)
  i = comb.length - 1
  loop do
    valid = true
    (i...comb.length).each do |j|
      if j == i
        comb[j] += 1
      else
        comb[j] = comb[i] + (j - i)
      end
      if comb[j] >= length
        valid = false
        break
      end
    end
    return true if valid
    i -= 1
    break unless i >= 0
  end
  return false
end

def pbEachCombination(array, num)
  return if array.length < num || num <= 0
  if array.length == num
    yield array
    return
  elsif num == 1
    array.each do |x|
      yield [x]
    end
    return
  end
  currentComb = []
  arr = []
  num.times { |i| currentComb[i] = i }
  loop do
    num.times { |i| arr[i] = array[currentComb[i]] }
    yield arr
    break unless _pbNextComb(currentComb, array.length)
  end
end
